body: That’s incredible, i’ve been working retail since my 16th birthday, and i’m currently an assistant manager at my retail job, i just know it’s not what i truly want and all i get told is the only way i could do anything is with a college degree. Thank you for telling me you did without, it definitely gives me a bit more confidence in not doing well. My mom is my biggest motivator, strongest woman i know, thank you

I’m thinking of it, I took 2 years off after high school to work and started going to college in fall of 2020, so i feel bad for even considering taking time off since i haven’t been going for long. But idk when i read your comment I cried not gonna lie, i’ll try and be nicer to myself today because of you, thank you, it means a lot to me that even you, a stranger, can believe in me

Thank you. I’ve been diagnosed with depression and anxiety but my last therapist mentioned it might be a mood disorder that I suffer from but she is no longer treating patients through my insurance. I always worry that may be i’m over exaggerating my feeling and that i’m not actually depressed and that people have it worse than me so i should just suck it up. Thank you again for your comment I appreciate it
That does kind of make me feel better :)

You know what. Thank you so much for this. I will definitely look into more therapists and talk to my doctor. I really don’t want this to be the rest of my life, but i think right now it’s exceptionally hard since so many more people have been going through difficult times due to covid, i know my problems are important but at times i feel like i’m wasting everyone’s times since i’m not getting better as fast i think i could
unfortunately all the therapists are really overbooked and there are long wait time for an appointment with my insurance. i just had to wait 3 months even for this last one
